Looks like he's controlling all my elves with that purple thing in his staff..
You must recover the artifact and defeat Krampus for good!|[[Santa]] dialogue on Wave 20 ([[Krampus Frosthold]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Krampus''' was the third and final boss that appeared in [[Krampus Frosthold]] as part of the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]. As with most major bosses, it had an extremely high amount of health, but walked quite slowly. It was immune to being frozen and having the chillness effect applied to it from freezing towers, it could not be slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]], and the [[Electroshocker]] and [[Warden]] could only slow it down instead of stunning it. '''Krampus''' had seven abilities: #Its ''Ryanair Flight'' ability caused '''Krampus''' to hop between the two middle paths of the map. When '''Krampus''' landed, it created a large shockwave, stunning towers around it. #Its ''Secret Santa'' ability summoned a large number of enemies by '''Krampus''', from 4-8 gifts which were thrown onto any of the four paths. These enemies could be the [[Papa Bread (Krampus Frosthold)|Papa Bread]], [[Evil Elf (Krampus Frosthold)|Evil Elf]], [[Packed Ice (Krampus Frosthold)|Packed Ice]], [[Crying Angel (Krampus Frosthold)|Crying Angel]], [[Frozen (Krampus Frosthold)|Frozen]], [[Cookie Guard (Krampus Frosthold)|Cookie Guard]], [[Snow Golem (Krampus Frosthold)|Snow Golem]] and [[Tough Cookie (Krampus Frosthold)|Tough Cookie]]. #Its ''Freezing Spell'' attack created a shockwave of ice that stunned towers. #Its ''Raining Spikes'' ability summoned 25-30 large icicles that rained down on the map and stunned towers hit for 5-7 seconds and dealt 100 damage to units. #Its ''Germanic Stomp'' ability makes it stomp on the ground, creating a shockwave that stuns towers for 6-10 seconds and deals 500 damage to units. #Its ''Body Slam'' ability made it jump into the air and start falling, which created ice spikes upon landing that stunned towers. #When '''Krampus''' reached half health, it activated its ''Lapland Turned Red'' rage mode ability. It would take off its mask and scream, gained 50,000 shield health, sped up, became [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] for a few seconds and started to use its abilities more frequently. It was invulnerable while it was screaming. All abilities that stunned towers also applied a 75% [[Fatigue Debuff]] to affected towers a few seconds after, including towers that could not get stunned like the [[Ranger]] and non-humanoid towers that normally could not have debuffs applied to them like the [[Pursuit]]. ==Appearance== '''Krampus''' was a giant, anthropomorphic half-goat and half-demon. It had black skin, red horns and light blue glowing eyes. It wore red and black shoulder-pads with blue spikes, black and red shirt with a hood, red elbow-pads, black pants, and red and grey knee-pads. Multiple parts of it clothing also had light grey fur on its edges. It also wore a large black helmet. On its back it had a staff powered by a [[God Cube]] shard, which it used to attack towers. Upon entering ''Lapland Turned Red'', it would take off its helmet and expose its face, and also gained blue neon lines on its skin. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, like the [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]] should be used against '''Krampus'''. **The [[Ranger]], [[Pursuit]] and [[Ace Pilot]] can be especially useful as they are immune to stuns, though they are still affected by the [[Fatigue Debuff]]. **As '''Krampus''' becomes hidden for a few seconds after '''Lapland Turned Red''', DPS towers with hidden detection like the [[Accelerator]] and [[Golden Minigunner]] are useful against this, as they can keep attacking '''Krampus''' even while it is hidden. **The [[DJ Booth]] and [[Commander]] are useful for boosting the towers' range and firerate respectively. ***The [[Commander]] can also be useful at mitigating the effects of the [[Fatigue Debuff]] it applies to all towers shortly after they get hit by its abilities. **The [[Medic]]'s ''Cleansing'' ability is extremely useful for cleansing stuns from '''Krampus'''' abilities, though it cannot cleanse the [[Fatigue Debuff]]. *All abilities that stun also damage units, making spawner towers like the [[Military Base]] and [[Necromancer]] worse against this. **The [[Engineer]] can still be useful as its sentries have a shield, which prevents them from being damaged as long as the [[Engineer]] is not stunned itself. *Area of effect towers, like the [[Mortar]] and [[Golden Pyromancer]] are highly recommended to deal with the hordes of enemies that spawn before and after '''Krampus''', as well as enemies spawned by '''Krampus'''' ''Secret Santa'' ability. *'''Krampus''' has the ability to jump between paths. Because of this, towers should be placed so that they can cover both paths of the map. **Do note that this ability can also stun your towers. **The [[DJ Booth]] can be especially helpful at increasing the range of your towers. **The [[Ranger]] is mostly unaffected by this, due to its high-range allowing it to cover most if not all of [[Krampus Frosthold]] in certain spots. *Because of its immunities, freezing towers and [[Toxic Gunner]] cannot stall '''Krampus'''. **The [[Electroshocker]] and [[Warden]] can only slow down '''Krampus''' instead of stunning it. **The [[Jester]]'s confusion bombs can be very effective at stalling '''Krampus'''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} KrampusRevengeGameThumbnail.png|'''Krampus''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} XMAS2023Icon1.png|'''Krampus''' on the game icon. XMAS2023Icon2.png|'''Krampus''' on the game icon. XMAS2023ICON3.png|'''Krampus''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} 2023XMASIconClean.jpg|'''Krampus''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Christmas 2023 Trailer|'''Krampus''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Stickers}} KrampusSticker.png|'''Krampus''' on the [[Krampus (Sticker)|Krampus]] sticker. {{GalleryHeader|Concept Art}} KrampusCA.jpg|'''Krampus''' on concept art. }} ==Trivia== *'''Krampus''' was a returning boss from the [[Christmas 2019 Event]], with the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]'s name stating that it had come back for revenge. It received a visual overhaul, and while its abilities got many visual changes, they roughly retained the same mechanics. **Unlike its previous version, '''Krampus'''' abilities were powered by the [[God Cube]], with a fragment of it being included in '''Krampus'''' staff. *'''Krampus''' was the only boss enemy that could become [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]], as it briefly became [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] after using its ''Lapland Turned Red'' ability. **Unlike all other [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies, it did not change its transparency over time during that ability, most likely due to it being a temporary attribute. *'''Krampus''' was the first enemy that can change which path it was on with its ''Ryanair Flight'' ability. *'''Krampus''', alongside [[Ducky D00M (D00M's Revenge)|Ducky D00M]] from [[D00M's Revenge]], [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] and [[Frost Spirit]] from the [[Operation I.C.E Event]] had the second highest number of abilities in the game, only behind the [[Rift Walker]]. *In folklore, the Krampus is a half-goat, half-demon monster in some legends. During the Christmas season, his role is to punish children who have misbehaved. **He originated from Germany. *'''Krampus'''' boss theme was a remix of the original [[Krampus (Village of Despair)|Krampus]] boss theme. **Interestingly, the theme played in the last stage of [[Krampus Frosthold]] instead of the final wave where '''Krampus''' appeared in. *A re-textured version of the helmet worn by '''Krampus''' was uploaded as an UGC, it is called {{RLinkC|15689733926|Krampus' Helmet}}. ==Update History== *'''21 December 2023''' - [[v1.11.0]] **'''Krampus''' added. *'''31 January 2024''' - [[v1.12.0]]c **'''Krampus''' removed. {{KrampusFrosthold|[[Present3 (Krampus Frosthold)|Present3]], [[Papa Bread (Krampus Frosthold)|Papa Bread]] & [[Builder Elf (Krampus Frosthold)|Builder Elf]]|Wave 18|Krampus, [[Evil Elf (Krampus Frosthold)|Evil Elf]], [[Sleigh (Krampus Frosthold)|Sleigh]] & [[Toy Soldier (Krampus Frosthold)|Toy Soldier]]|Wave 20|End|N/A}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Bosses]] {{DISPLAYTITLE:Krampus}}
